change: Require complete per-rollout call identities and disjoint identities between screen and confirmation.
covered_cases: Missing call records, labels or response IDs cannot establish a signal.
Malformed response hashes cannot establish a signal.
A request or response reused across screen and confirmation cannot confirm a signal.
Legacy missing-identity archives retain descriptive scores without confirmation eligibility.
Negative, incorrectly typed or reward-inconsistent grader diagnostics are rejected.
public_identity_fields: Client labels are hashed; provider response IDs were already stored as hashes.
